test_title: RRB Technician Grade III Official Paper (Held On: 27 Dec, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which of the following was a significant outcome of the informal meeting between Xi Jinping and Narendra Modi at the 2023 BRICS summit?

options.text: A decision to increase trade between the two countries
A commitment to de-escalate tensions along the contested border
A pledge to resolve territorial disputes through war

solution:
The correct answer is __**A commitment to de-escalate tensions along the contested border**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• During the 2023 BRICS summit, Xi Jinping and Narendra Modi held an informal meeting to address bilateral issues.
 
• One of the significant outcomes was a mutual commitment to de-escalate border tensions.
 
• Both leaders agreed to take steps to reduce the presence of troops along the Line of Actual Control (LAC).
 
• This commitment aims to foster a peaceful and stable border environment between India and China.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Line of Actual Control (LAC)**:

 
 
• The LAC is the demarcation that separates Indian-controlled territory from Chinese-controlled territory.
 
• It is not a legally recognized international boundary but a practical border line.
 
 
 
• **BRICS Summit**:
 
 
• BRICS is an acronym for the association of five major emerging national economies: Brazil, Russia, India, China, and South Africa.
 
• The summit serves as a platform for collaboration on economic, political, and cultural issues.
 
 
 
• **Border Disputes**:
 
 
• India and China have a long-standing border dispute, particularly in regions like Aksai Chin and Arunachal Pradesh.
 
• The conflict has led to several military standoffs over the years.
 
 
 
• **Military De-Escalation**:
 
 
• De-escalation involves reducing military forces to minimize the risk of conflict.
 
• It often includes measures like troop withdrawals and the establishment of buffer zones.
